```swift
import Foundation
import NaturalLanguage

// MARK: - AutoTagger

enum SuggestionStatus: String, Codable {
    case suggested, accepted, dismissed, userAdded
}

struct AutoTagger {
    func moodScore(from text: String) -> Double {
        let tagger = NLTagger(tagSchemes: [.sentimentScore])
        tagger.string = text
        var totalSentiment = 0.0
        var count = 0
        
        tagger.enumerateTags(in: text.startIndex..<text.endIndex, unit: .sentence, scheme: .sentimentScore) { tag, range in
            if let sentimentValue = tag?.rawValue {
                totalSentiment += Double(sentimentValue)!
                count += 1
            }
            return true
        }
        
        return count > 0 ? totalSentiment / Double(count) : 0.0
    }
    
    func suggestTags(from text: String) -> [String] {

        return []
    }
}
```
